title: 乐观更新
summary: 点完这一击，界面是等网络回执还是立即改？成功是默认路径，UI 先行响应；若网络失败，根据快照原位回滚并说明原因；不可逆高风险操作禁止乐观更新。
summaryEn: When an action is clicked, does the UI wait for network ACK or commit optimistically? Success is the default path, UI reacts immediately; on failure, roll back in place with a snapshot and explain why.
asks: 点完这一击，界面是等网络回执还是立即改？
asksEn: When an action is clicked, does the UI wait for network ACK or commit optimistically?
